notes: Themes' art is its own layers (CEO: "if a theme has graphics it needs a layer"): Herse (Haze), Orthosie (Paper), Isonoe (HUD, Scan lines), Adrastea (Texture), Arche (Texture, Rulers), Pasiphae (Grid, Neon), Thebe (Weave), Dia (Dot grid)…

Cards › Opacity works on a fresh install: a card the text would not read on at the opacity chosen (white on Dark) is drawn at the most it can be and still read, where it went back to 10% and the slider looked dead.

Ganymede: a card you gave other data (a Calendar where the GPU was) keeps that card's place in the computer's card order; on a smaller layout it fell to the end of the list and was dropped (since 1.1.1232).
Editor: the Size chip names a screen Windows gives no name (a laptop's own panel) as Main screen, where it named none.
Placement rig: it waits for the portal window to come back before measuring it (Blink's hs156kcb home failed one gauntlet run in three on "reading 'b'").
